differences.completePart01Value:
BRP01-PW-01 — Pact Automaton Sentinel / Pressure Wave.
PRINTED: one target; save DC15; 3d8 force on failure; an unspecified control effect. Printed save ability, range, control definition and success effect are missing.
NEW: one perceived, legally targetable creature within30ft of a declared emitter point on the Sentinel's actual body, with an unobstructed line to an actual interior target point. Record emitter and target-point positions at release. The emitter cannot be moved outside the body to gain range. Range is Euclidean for this expressly scoped three-dimensional action; this is not a global grid rewrite.
This is a magical nonspell native force action, not a learned spell or class resource. It requires one real Action, or one of the two selections in this Sentinel's printed Multiattack; that limited substitution is explicit NEW authorship. Each selected Wave has its own save/dice/root. No RP, V/S/F, ammunition, concentration or recharge is added. Current source-qualified suppression can prevent its magical output; ordinary spell-only Counterspell does not become permission to counter this nonspell.
After actual interruptions and target revalidation, make one STR save DC15. Success prevents both damage and push; do not roll damage and do not apply half damage. Failure rolls3d8 force once. After that damage's actual life/concentration consequences, a still-eligible living recipient is pushed up to10ft in the fixed direction from the discharge emitter through the declared target point. Normalize that direction; zero-length origin-to-target is illegal at declaration. Sweep the recipient's whole body along it, stopping at the first placement obstruction. An actual push-reduction effect such as already-paid Brace applies within its own scope. No size exemption or extra save is invented.
The push is instantaneous: no Prone, Stunned, restraint, persistent zone or repeated tick is added. Completed damage/push remains after source suppression, death or later removal; those events before discharge can prevent that pending discharge. It does not move a now-dead body as a new creature effect.
Containment Pulse stays separate and unchanged: area, STR DC15,5d6 force, half on success, Recharge5–6 and its printed charge-up. Its unspecified area, formation mechanics and broader recharge/Multiattack questions remain for their own parts. It is not a Pressure Wave variant and is not granted as a slot in this Part01's two-selection substitution.
Reason/tradeoff: a resisted single-target10ft displacement supplies meaningful disruption without importing an area blast, Prone or another game's profile. One-third of the printed damage has not been removed: success-zero follows the printed 'succeed ... or take' conditional. All missing parameters are NEW proposals.

completeReturn02Value.wording: For these proposed profiles only use the explicit per-body box and weight in each procedure. Occupancy is the interior of that box; mere boundary contact is not overlap. A body cannot voluntarily end in solid matter or another body's interior. Range/reach is minimum Euclidean separation between actual occupied bodies; a target can be hit at exactly the stated maximum. An area needs a real interior intersection and line of effect from its declared outlet/center to a point in that same intersection. No witness on an unexposed face suffices. Cone geometry is axial 0<s<=length and perpendicular radius<=s/2, excluding the rear half-space. A spherical area uses its stated center/radius. Whole-body fit and actual collision/support are required throughout movement and arrival. Positive-body intersection, not a token-center test, governs these local areas. These shapes do not replace another accepted spell's grid/continuous conventions. Sight/perception, cover, light and knowledge are separate: knowing a location supplies no sight. Native ranged attacks within five feet of a hostile creature that sees the attacker use the actual close-combat disadvantage. Real half/three-quarter cover adds its actual +2/+5; total cover blocks the required path. A larger body neither sees nor attacks through a wall by default.

differences.completePart01Value:
BRP01-DIM-TAIL-01 — Dimetrodon / Tail Sweep.
Tactics names Tail Sweep and preparation names bludgeoning, but no Tail Sweep action statistics are printed. Preserve the existing Sail-Back Bite and all source text.
NEW: a physical natural melee attack, reach5ft, one perceived legal creature, +4 to hit,1d6+2 bludgeoning. Critical damage is2d6+2. One real Action; no Multiattack, Bonus Action, recharge or helper-triggered Reaction is granted. Attack magnitude uses this creature's own printed Bite benchmark; the following control is expressly NEW.
On a hit, apply damage first. If the same recipient remains a creature eligible for Prone, it then makes one DEX save against this profile's printed save-DC benchmark13. Failure applies actual Prone; success adds no Prone but does not refund the hit's damage. A miss causes neither damage nor the rider save. Actual Prone immunity prevents the rider, not the bludgeoning packet. An already-Prone recipient is not given a stacking penalty, new duration or stand-cost increase.
No area or automatic push is inferred from 'Sweep'. Prone lasts until a lawful stand or real removal; standing requires nonzero current Speed and floor(half current Speed) movement, with actual remaining budget. It survives the Dimetrodon's later source removal because posture already changed. Flying/support consequences use actual Falling rules, not free impact damage.
For comparing the original action, Sail-Back Bite stays+4,1d6+2 piercing and is completed as physical5ft one-target melee with no new rider. Same damage budget does not establish balance equivalence; Tail's new posture utility is a proposed tactical benefit pending independent review.

This is a named native alternative, not a sweep over unlisted targets.

differences.completePart01Value:
BRP01-SNAKE-CONSTRICT-01 — Giant Constrictor Snake / Constrict.
Tactics names Constrict and preparation names bludgeoning, but the only printed damage action is Bite+3,1d6+1 piercing. Keep that Bite, Huge size,18HP,AC11,CR1/4 and all other printed values exact.
NEW: a physical natural melee Constrict, reach5ft, one perceived legal creature no more than one size category larger than the snake and with actual space for its body-contact coil. No tail-only remote grab is invented. Attack+3; hit1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical2d6+1. One real Action. This uses the printed Bite magnitude as the explicit numeric benchmark, not a foreign constrictor profile.
After hit damage/life processing, a still-eligible recipient makes STR DC14, using the profile's printed save-DC benchmark. Failure creates one source-qualified Grappled relationship to this snake with5ft maintained reach. Success prevents the relationship, not damage. Grappled immunity blocks only the rider. A miss supplies neither damage nor that save.
This NEW natural coil occupies one designated coiling appendage and can hold only one recipient at a time. It is not a hand-based ordinary opposed grapple. While occupied, Constrict may attack that same recipient again for its normal paid attack/damage, but does not reroll admission, refresh or duplicate the existing grapple. A different recipient requires the old grip to end first. Existing Bite can still be used at a lawful opportunity without automatically ending the hold.
Escape costs the recipient one Action and a STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) fixed-DC14 task check; use only actual applicable proficiency. The two upper task degrees end this one relationship; other results retain it, without an invented injury. Release is free on the snake's own turn. The relationship also ends on snake Incapacitated/death/removal, target death/removal, or actual reach breaking, including forced movement/teleport; current target Speed returns to whatever its other real sources permit.
No Restrained, paralysis, suffocation, swallowed state, recurring free damage, concentration or extra action is added. A squeeze on a later turn remains a paid Constrict attack. Maintaining Grappled does not itself take away the target's Action or Reaction.
For the original Bite demonstration, its unchanged+3 and1d6+1 piercing use physical5ft one-target melee. Reason/tradeoff: this selects finite damage plus escapable movement control while retaining the unusually low printed CR/HP and explicit attack modifier; the record is not re-rated to satisfy a spell test.

completeReturn02Value.name: Constrict
completeReturn02Value.procedure: NEW tactic completion: one Action, melee5ft attack+3; on hit1d6+1 bludgeoning, then STR DC14 resists a single-body Grappled restraint. Only a creature no larger than the snake's printed Huge size qualifies. One grapple at a time; occupied coils cannot hold another. No Restrained, ongoing crush or extra bite is granted. Escape takes an actual Action with STR or DEX save DC14, not ungranted Athletics proficiency; forced separation beyond5ft, release, death/incapacitation or an applicable actual effect ends it. This explicitly authored source save is distinct from the Core opposed ordinary grapple and does not repair the unrelated companion-contest hold.

distinctScopes: Part01 only BV3-04/05/06; other24 mapped questions intentionally open.
Return02 is whole proposed bestiary with additional native actions, traits, geometry, materials, knowledge and lifecycle authorship; completeness claim is not independently accepted.

Return02 adds Containment Pulse to eligible charged Multiattack slots; Part01 deliberately excludes it from bounded scope. This is scope expansion requiring review, not automatically an accidental contradiction.
interimBoundary: Earlier visible interim Part01 hashes and counts differ from the actual final downloaded files. Interim claims are history only; the preserved final Part01 has23 cases,56 transitions,5 operations and279 self-reported checks.
